old_caption: The video begins with a close-up shot of a hand holding a CD. The hand is positioned over a device, likely a CD player or burner, which is placed on a flat surface. The CD is being carefully rotated by the hand. As the hand moves the CD, it reflects light, creating a rainbow-like effect on its surface. The background shows part of a room with a red and white patterned fabric and a metallic object, possibly a piece of furniture or equipment. The hand continues to adjust the CD's position while rotating it. The video captures the meticulous process of manipulating the CD on the device, emphasizing the reflective properties of the disc and the careful handling by the hand.
original_wisa_caption: The video begins with a close-up shot of a hand holding a CD. The hand is positioned over an open CD case, which is placed on a flat surface. The CD is being carefully inserted into the case. As the hand moves the CD, it reflects light, creating a rainbow-like effect on its surface. The background shows part of a room with a red and white patterned fabric and a metallic object, possibly a piece of furniture or equipment. The hand continues to adjust the CD's position until it is fully seated inside the case. The video captures the meticulous process of inserting the CD into the case, emphasizing the reflective properties of the disc and the careful handling by the hand.
caption: A close, slightly high-angle view shows a silver compact disc lying flat on a black hexagonal platform. Its underside flashes broad iridescent rainbow reflections around an orange central hub. A right hand enters repeatedly from the right side, fingertips resting on and sliding across the disc surface. The fingers first touch the right rim, then migrate inward to press near the orange hub, casting soft shadows that track their movement. They next sweep over the upper-left portion of the disc before returning to the right edge, where they linger and slide along the rim. Later the hand spreads again across the left and top of the disc. The camera tilts slowly, gradually revealing more of a white panel with a red geometric pattern at the upper left.
